title: CIA official blocking transfer of a non-human craft between Lockheed and Bigelow

tellings.quote: Greenwald, who's director of science and technology of the CIA, who's blocking UFO transfer between Lockheed and Bigelow, which we just discussed with Lacatski.

plain: An official named Greenwald, director of science and technology at the CIA, is said to have blocked the transfer of a UFO between the aerospace companies Lockheed and Bigelow. Michels says this himself in a heated episode with the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell, pointing back to an earlier interview with James Lacatski, a former Pentagon intelligence official, and citing the Las Vegas journalist George Knapp. If true, it would mean a private company holds a craft and the CIA has stepped in to control where it goes.
